moral: Believing in yourself helps you fulfill your destiny.

story: Seraphina is chosen by the king to fulfill a prophecy and defeat the Shadow Wyvern threatening the kingdom. Along her journey with Elric, she faces danger and uncertainty. As she travels, she discovers that she is part of an ancient prophecy. Accepting her destiny, she finds the courage within herself and defeats the Wyvern, restoring peace to the kingdom.
